title: Pointwise-equal families have equal signed finite sums
statement: `(forall k, f k = g k) -> Int.sumRange f n = Int.sumRange g n`. Induction on the bound; the base is `Eq.refl` at `Int.zero` and the step rewrites the prior sum by the induction hypothesis and the fresh term by the pointwise hypothesis. `Kernel::axiom_footprint` is EMPTY. Admitted by the trusted gate on the first attempt.

formal.statement: theorem Int.sumRange_congr : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Int)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> Int)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : ((x3 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Int (x0 x3) (x1 x3))) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.sumRange x0 x2) (Int.sumRange x1 x2)))))
